name: YouTube Mandala Promo — Free Pipeline for Shorts
description: Create a completely free pipeline for generating YouTube Shorts to promote Mandala Symbiosis philosophy, products, and ecosystem. Uses nstc-pipeline (free), AI-generated text from External SR, and free visual assets. Focus on foreign audience and brand awareness.
effort_estimate: Initial setup: 5-10 hours. Then 1-2 hours per week for content curation.

tool_stack.pipeline: nstc-pipeline — free, open-source, creates Shorts from text + visuals
tool_stack.text_generation: External SR (DeepSeek/Claude) — generate script from Mandala knowledge base
tool_stack.visuals: Free stock video libraries (Pexels, Pixabay) + abstract animations
tool_stack.music: Free AI music generators (Suno, Udio) or YouTube Audio Library
tool_stack.upload: Manual upload via YouTube Studio (or yutu if needed later)
tool_stack.voiceover: Free TTS (Edge TTS, Google TTS) or no voiceover — text-only with music

phase_0_setup.name: Tool Setup & Testing
phase_0_setup.description: Install nstc-pipeline, gather free visual assets, test first Short.
tasks: Install nstc-pipeline (clone repo, install dependencies)
Create folder for Mandala assets (logo, colors, fonts)
Download 50+ free abstract/nature videos for visuals (Pexels, Pixabay)
Test nstc-pipeline with a simple text and visual
Create first test Short (manual upload to YouTube)
deliverables: Library of free visuals for Mandala content

phase_1_content_pipeline.name: Content Pipeline Setup
phase_1_content_pipeline.description: Create a workflow for generating scripts and turning them into Shorts.
tasks: Identify 10 key Mandala concepts for first batch (from PHI blocks)
Generate scripts using External SR (DeepSeek) — 30-60 seconds each
Match each script with visual assets (abstract, nature, geometry)
Generate Shorts using nstc-pipeline
Set up simple tracking for which concepts perform best

phase_2_optimization.name: Optimization & Scaling
phase_2_optimization.description: Analyze performance, optimize format, increase publishing frequency.
tasks: Analyze best-performing Shorts (topic, length, visual style)
Refine script templates based on data
Increase publishing to 3-5 Shorts per week
Experiment with different visual styles (text-only, voiceover, music)
Start building a small community (comments, engagement)

phase_3_brand_building.name: Brand Building & Ecosystem Integration
phase_3_brand_building.description: Link Shorts to other Mandala channels (GitHub, products, community).
tasks: Add calls-to-action to Mandala products (Gentle Companion, Engineer Chat)
Create a 'philosophy series' playlist
Cross-promote with other channels (if any)
Start using yutu or similar for semi-automated uploads
Track conversion to Mandala ecosystem (new visitors, GitHub stars, bot users)
deliverables: Active community in comments (10+ engaged users per video)
Measurable traffic to Mandala ecosystem from YouTube

success_metrics.phase_1: 10 Shorts published, average 500+ views per Short
success_metrics.phase_3: 1000+ subscribers, measurable traffic to Mandala ecosystem

financial_note: This pipeline is designed to be completely free. No paid subscriptions required. All tools have free tiers or are open-source. The goal is brand awareness, not direct monetization (though AdSense can be added later).

connectivity.relationship: Part of the financial sustainability track — builds visibility for Mandala ecosystem.

notes: Start with text-only Shorts (no voiceover) to keep it simple and free.
Use free visuals from Pexels/Pixabay — search for 'meditation', 'nature', 'abstract', 'geometry'.
External SR (DeepSeek/Claude) will generate scripts based on Mandala philosophy blocks.
This is a low-cost, high-visibility experiment. Even modest success (1k subs) creates valuable brand presence.
Mandala itself is the product — YouTube is the distribution channel.
source: Dialogue between Gardener (Voodoo) and External SR (DeepSeek), 2026-07-13
